description.en:
Fourier N1, also called Nexus1, is a compact humanoid platform for motion research and embodied-intelligence development. Its documented configuration is 1.3 metres tall and 38 kg, with 23 degrees of freedom: five in each arm, six in each leg and one at the waist.

The design supports experiments in walking, running, balance and recovery. Fourier reports demonstrations involving slopes, stairs and standing on one foot, with an expandable head section for additional perception equipment. The technical documentation exposes joint layouts and motion limits, helping developers connect control algorithms to the physical platform and evaluate behaviors against its mechanical constraints.
